label: What is a function
subgoals: Assign each x in A exactly one f(x) in B
Tag A the domain and B the codomain
Test x1 != x2 implies f(x1) != f(x2)

label: What is not a function
subgoals: Flag x = -3 mapping to both 7 and 10
Enforce one y per x via unique-existence
Run the vertical-line test on the graph

label: Difference between codomain and range
subgoals: Read the codomain B off the f: A -> B declaration
Collect attained f(x) values into the range
Fit the range inside the codomain as a subset
